```{r}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(rnaturalearth)



land <- ne_countries(
  scale = 10,   # ← numeric 10, NOT "large"
  returnclass = "sf"
)

bbox_thomas <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(
  xmin = -65.05, ymin = 18.28,
  xmax = -64.80, ymax = 18.42
), crs = 4326))

land_thomas <- st_crop(land, bbox_thomas)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land_thomas,
          fill = "grey90",
          color = "black",
          linewidth = 0.3) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-65.05, -64.80),
           ylim = c(18.28, 18.42),
           expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
# ====== PACKAGES ==============================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(osmdata)
library(ggspatial)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(grid)              
library(rnaturalearth)    
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(curl)

# ====== SITE DATA =============================================================
sites <- data.frame(
  Name = c("CAHS", "IEKHS", "Antilles School", "BCB (field trips)",
           "Hull Bay", "STEER", "Range Cay Nursery (UVI)",
           "Complex High (STX)", "Altona Lagoon", "Salt River Bay", "Feather Leaf Inn"),
  Type = c("School", "School", "School", "School",
           "Field Site", "Field Site", "Field Site",
           "School", "Field Site", "Field Site", "Field Site"),
  Island = c("St. Thomas", "St. Thomas", "St. Thomas", "St. Thomas",
             "St. Thomas", "St. Thomas", "St. Thomas",
             "St. Croix", "St. Croix", "St. Croix", "St. Croix"),
  Latitude = c(18.3420, 18.3249, 18.3235, 18.3179,
               18.3703, 18.3147, 18.3365,
               17.7361, 17.7513, 17.7767, 17.748956),
  Longitude = c(-64.9196, -64.8544, -64.9101, -64.8910,
                -64.9546, -64.8495, -64.9751,
                -64.7656, -64.6924, -64.7617, -64.891855)
)

sites_sf <- st_as_sf(sites, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
st_thomas_sites <- dplyr::filter(sites_sf, Island == "St. Thomas")
st_croix_sites  <- dplyr::filter(sites_sf, Island == "St. Croix")

# ====== BOUNDING BOXES ========================================================
bbox_thomas <- c(xmin = -65.05, ymin = 18.28, xmax = -64.80, ymax = 18.42)
bbox_croix  <- c(xmin = -64.92, ymin = 17.68, xmax = -64.56, ymax = 17.88)
bbox_global <- c(xmin = -90.00, ymin = 10.00, xmax = -55.00, ymax = 30.00)

# ====== OVERPASS SETTINGS =====================================================
options(osmdata_overpass_url = "https://overpass.kumi.systems/api/interpreter")
options(osmdata_timeout = 120)


fetch_osm_coast <- function(bbox) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      opq(bbox = bbox, timeout = 120) |>
        add_osm_feature(key = "natural", value = "coastline") |>
        osmdata_sf()
    },
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

# OSM for islands
coastline_thomas <- fetch_osm_coast(bbox_thomas)
coastline_croix  <- fetch_osm_coast(bbox_croix)

# Natural Earth for Caribbean
coast_world <- rnaturalearth::ne_coastline(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
carib_poly <- sf::st_sfc(
  sf::st_polygon(list(matrix(c(
    -90, 10,
    -55, 10,
    -55, 30,
    -90, 30,
    -90, 10
  ), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE))),
  crs = 4326
)
coast_carib <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_intersection(coast_world, carib_poly))

# ====== COLORS & SHAPES =======================================================
colors <- c("School" = "#3366FF", "Field Site" = "#33CC33")
shape_vals <- c("School" = 16, "Field Site" = 17)

# ====== ST. THOMAS MAP ========================================================
st_thomas_map <- ggplot() +
  { if (!is.null(coastline_thomas) && !is.null(coastline_thomas$osm_lines))
    geom_sf(data = coastline_thomas$osm_lines, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4)
  } +
  geom_sf(data = st_thomas_sites, aes(color = Type, shape = Type), size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = st_thomas_sites,
    aes(geometry = geometry, label = Name),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf, nudge_y = 0.005
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = bbox_thomas[c("xmin", "xmax")],
           ylim = bbox_thomas[c("ymin", "ymax")], expand = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, name = "Site type") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_vals, name = "Site type") +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 5)),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 5))
  ) +
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr", which_north = "true",
    pad_x = grid::unit(0.3, "in"), pad_y = grid::unit(0.2, "in"),
    style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering()
  ) +
  labs(title = "MIC Sites in St. Thomas, USVI", x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    #legend.position = c(0.03, 0.97),
    legend.justification = c("left", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80"),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.4, "in"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
  )

st_thomas_map

# ====== ST. CROIX MAP =========================================================
st_croix_map <- ggplot() +
  { if (!is.null(coastline_croix) && !is.null(coastline_croix$osm_lines))
    geom_sf(data = coastline_croix$osm_lines, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4)
  } +
  geom_sf(data = st_croix_sites, aes(color = Type, shape = Type), size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = st_croix_sites,
    aes(geometry = geometry, label = Name),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.3
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = bbox_croix[c("xmin", "xmax")],
           ylim = bbox_croix[c("ymin", "ymax")], expand = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, name = "Site type") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_vals, name = "Site type") +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 5)),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 5))
  ) +
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr", which_north = "true",
    pad_x = grid::unit(0.3, "in"), pad_y = grid::unit(0.2, "in"),
    style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering()
  ) +
  labs(title = "MIC Sites in St. Croix, USVI", x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.03, 0.97),
    legend.justification = c("left", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80"),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.4, "in"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
  )

st_croix_map

# ====== CARIBBEAN MAP =========================================================
# Helper for circle
circle_df <- function(cx, cy, r_lon = 0.35, r_lat = 0.35, n = 360) {
  th <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = n)
  data.frame(x = cx + r_lon * cos(th), y = cy + r_lat * sin(th))
}
usvi_ring <- circle_df(cx = -64.75, cy = 18.35, r_lon = 0.35, r_lat = 0.35)

caribbean_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = coast_carib, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-90, -55), ylim = c(10, 30), expand = FALSE) +
  geom_path(data = usvi_ring, aes(x, y),
            color = "red", linewidth = 1.3, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = -64.8, y = 18.95, label = "U. S. Virgin Islands",
           size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr", which_north = "true",
    pad_x = grid::unit(0.3, "in"), pad_y = grid::unit(0.2, "in"),
    style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering()
  ) +
  labs(title = "Map of the Caribbean", x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")  # hide legend here
caribbean_map
print(caribbean_map)
# ====== SAVE MAPS =============================================================
ggsave("st_thomas_map.png", plot = st_thomas_map, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave("st_croix_map.png",  plot = st_croix_map,  width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave("caribbean_map.png", plot = caribbean_map, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")




```
